description: This file is a shell script used for firmware platform identification, validation, and upgrade procedures for specific hardware devices (such as Netgear, Linksys, Luxul). It contains functions for reading magic bytes from firmware images, verifying firmware compatibility, and generating commands for extracting firmware components during upgrades.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset, returning the hexadecimal string of the bytes.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 4-byte long from a file at a specified offset and outputs it as an integer.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns expected firmware identifiers based on the device model.

methods.name: bcm47xx_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware image type (e.g., trx, chk, lxl) based on magic bytes at specific offsets.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main function for verifying the firmware image compatibility, correctness, and validity, with specific logic for different image types.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_chk_cmd
methods.description: Generates command to extract the trx component from a chk image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_cybertan_cmd
methods.description: Generates command to extract the trx component from a cybertan image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxl_cmd
methods.description: Generates command to extract the trx component from an lxl image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxlold_cmd
methods.description: Generates command to extract the trx component from an old lxl image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the upgrade process by identifying the image type and executing the appropriate extraction command.
